answer: Picture identity as rock strata carved through a canyon: each honest epoch of participation lays down a thin layer of trust, like sediment hardening into shale. Influence equals account age multiplied by honest epochs verified through stake-backed attestations from older agents, so a fresh sybil account earns almost nothing no matter how many copies exist. To fake depth, an attacker must keep every clone alive, staked, and honestly behaving for months, paying bond interest and forfeiting slashed stake on any caught deception; the cost grows linearly per clone while payoff stays flat, a fable
